header.title: User Guide
header.description: Welcome. Tasukiba Knowledge Relay is a project management platform that automatically reuses lessons learned from past projects in new ones.

overview.title: Service Overview
overview.description: As projects progress, the same decisions and roadblocks keep recurring — "We made this call before" or "We got stuck on this exact issue." This service consolidates WBS, risks, issues, retrospectives, and knowledge in one space, and automatically surfaces relevant past cases in new projects to break the cycle.

flow.step1Body: Enter an overview and related past knowledge, risks, and issues appear automatically in the "References" tab
flow.step2Body: Decompose work into WP → Activity, assign owners and estimated hours, visualize progress with Gantt chart
flow.step3Body: Log risks, issues, retrospectives, and knowledge as they arise — turn team tacit knowledge into explicit records
flow.step4Body: Captured insights are automatically surfaced in the "References" tab of future projects

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.searchHint: Use Ctrl+F (Cmd+F) to search by keyword.
glossary.defProject: The top-level unit of work. WBS, risks, issues, retrospectives, knowledge, etc. all live under a project.
glossary.defWbs: Work decomposed into a hierarchy of WP (Work Package) → Activity (actual task). Owners and estimated hours are assigned at the Activity level.
glossary.defGantt: A timeline view of tasks. Visualize deadline overruns and parallel workloads at a glance.
glossary.defRiskIssue: Risk = a potential obstacle that hasn't occurred yet. Issue = an active blocker that has already materialized.
glossary.defRetroKnowledge: Retrospective = a post-project KPT reflection. Knowledge = standalone documents capturing business know-how.
glossary.defMention: Type @username in a comment to send that user a notification.
glossary.defOwl: The official mascot "Tasuki Owl" lives in the bottom-right corner of every page. Click to open the chat panel and ask questions about past assets in natural language. The owl searches across Projects, Knowledge, Risks, Issues, Retrospectives, Memos, and attachments (free and unlimited on all plans).
glossary.defSuggestion: Automatically surfaces past risks, issues, and knowledge similar to the current project. Pro plan also includes AI-generated explanations of why each item is relevant.
glossary.defTenant: The top-level boundary for a company or organization. Data is completely isolated between tenants.
glossary.defPlan: Beginner = Free, up to 5 seats (50 project create/update operations per month). Expert = Unlimited seats, ¥10/project create or update. Pro = Unlimited seats, ¥15/operation + AI-powered suggestions with explanations.
